following the boundary of the municipal waters which the munici-
pality of Asia should have pursuant to the provisions of section
2921 of the Revised Administrative Code to the point of beginning.
The municipality of Cauayan shall consist of its pres-
ent territory minus the territory comprised in the munic-
§pality of Asia.
The municipality herein organized shall begin to. exist
upon the appointment and qualification of the mayor, vice-
mayor, and a majority of the municipal councilors thereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 20th day of November,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-
eight, and of the Independence of the Philippines, the
